well_summary: The GEAR SODA LAKE 103 HZ 15-31-46-23W3M (16-36) well was spud on February 14, 2024 at 05:00 hours and reached a total depth of 1979.00m on February 17, 2024 at 21:20 hours. The well is a horizontal well and targeted the McLaren.

The drilling contractor was Ensign Drilling Inc. and Pacesetter provided directional services. Geological supervision was provided by Ron Hickey and David Montgomery on behalf of Chinook Consulting Services.

The well was drilled from surface location 16-36-046-24W3M. Surface coordinates were 266.0m South of North, 107.0m West of East boundary of section 36-46-24W3, situated at a ground level elevation of 571.40m (Reference: Sea Level). Bottomhole coordinates were 22.16m South, 1615.49m East of surface location at a true vertical depth (TVD) of 441.95m from kelly bushing (575.90m). Total depth was reached at 1979.0m, in the McLaren.
The surface hole was drilled with Gel mud from 0.0m to 115.0m using 1 bits of 375.0mm. The surface hole was cased with a surface casing of 298.0mm, type H-40/ST&C, 62.00(kg/m) set at 115.0m.

An intermediate hole was drilled with flocc/polymer mud from 115.0m to 611.0m using 1 bits of 270.0mm with a cumulated drill time of 8.00 hours. The intermediate hole was cased with intermediate casing of 219.0mm, type J-55/Lt&C, 41.00(kg/m) set at 611.00m.

The main hole was drilled with polymer mud from 611.0m to 1979.0m using 1 bits of 200.0mm with a cumulated drill time of 22.50 hours. A production casing consisting of 139.7mm, type J-55/Lt&C, 23.00(kg/m) set at 1979.00m was subsequently run.
A total of 2 drilling bits were used to drill the well, with a cumulative drill time of 30.50 hours, resulting in an average penetration rate of 61.1m/hr.

Total gas was monitored using a Pason Gas Analyzer gas detector. Drill cutting samples were collected over the interval 380 to 611m, 5m intervals, 611 to 1979m, 30m intervals for Gear Energy Ltd. and none required for the SEM.
Wireline logs were not run. MWD Gamma was recorded.

formation_evaluation: Objectives: The primary objective of the GEAR SODA LAKE 103 HZ 15-31-46-23W3M (16-36) well was the McLaren Formation.

It was encountered at a measured depth of 559.10m (True Vertical Depth 455.40m, Subsea 120.50m). MWD Gamma confirmed the top of the formation at measured depth of 559.10m (True Vertical Depth 455.40m, Subsea 120.50m).
Based on cuttings examination, gas response and porosity estimates, the reservoir was evaluated as follows:
The GEAR SODA LAKE 103 HZ 15-31-46-23W3M (16-36) well was completed as a cased horizontal McLaren crude oil production well.
